name: PP-DocLayoutV3 (safetensors)
usage: OCR: layout analysis and reading order (for PaddleOCR-VL 1.5/1.6 and GLM-OCR)

release_date.note: createdAt of the repository; later commits change the README only

languages.note: French and German not listed explicitly

runtimes.value: Transformers (AutoModelForObjectDetection, PPDocLayoutV3ForObjectDetection). The official paddleocr pipeline on Apple Silicon runs layout only with PaddlePaddle; its transformers engine is marked as pending verification on Apple Silicon; without layout_detection_model_dir the pipeline downloads the official Paddle-format model at first run

web.scope: Released 20.01.2026 (weights); window: since 15.05.2026 plus the launch discussions. Hugging Face discussions of both PP-DocLayoutV3 repositories. Reddit not read. **Feedback thin.**
web.summary: Few reports: safetensors fastest of three back-ends on an NVIDIA GPU; some pages, often small images, return no layout at all; nothing on French or German.
web.verdict: Small shared layout module; thin feedback; Mac pipeline support unclear

comments.text: Safetensors (PyTorch) is the fastest of the three back-ends, about 42 ms per image against 55 ms for ONNX and 64 ms for Paddle, on an RTX 5060 Ti ([HF #8, 21.03.2026, launch](https://huggingface.co/PaddlePaddle/PP-DocLayoutV3/discussions/8)).

On 2,000 test images, some returned no layout result at all, especially small images, including 52 English pages; translated from Chinese ([HF #6, 10.03.2026, launch](https://huggingface.co/PaddlePaddle/PP-DocLayoutV3/discussions/6)).
